title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the document.

extractions.description: This paper investigates offline model-based optimization to enhance design processes across various domains like materials and DNA sequences. It introduces a novel parallel-mentoring method among parallel proxies to develop more robust models capable of handling out-of-distribution data. The approach involves voting-based pairwise supervision and adaptive soft-labeling across three proxies, collectively termed tri-mentoring.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper discusses enhancing design processes in various domains, it does not specifically focus on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development as core themes. The primary focus is on improving model-based optimization techniques.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We study offline model-based optimization to maximize a black-box objective function with a static dataset of designs and scores. These designs encompass a variety of domains, including materials, robots and DNA sequences.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily addresses optimization techniques without a direct tie to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development goals. It focuses on improving design processes through AI and deep learning models, but does not emphasize climate-specific applications.
primary_category.quote: Designing new objects or entities to optimize specific properties is a widespread challenge, encompassing various domains such as materials, robots, and DNA sequences.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes were identified as the core focus remains on AI optimization techniques across various domains with no substantial or direct link to sustainability.
secondary_categories.quote: A common approach trains a proxy on the static dataset to approximate the black-box objective function and performs gradient ascent to obtain new designs.

primary_sub_category.quote: However, this often results in poor designs due to the proxy inaccuracies for out-of-distribution designs.

new_primary_category.quote: We propose parallel-mentoring as an effective and novel method that facilitates mentoring among parallel proxies, creating a more robust ensemble to mitigate the out-of-distribution issue.
